◇  Found 5 skills

│
◇  Available Skills
│
│    firebase-development:add-feature
│
│      Adds Cloud Functions, Firestore collections, and API endpoints to existing Firebase projects using TDD. Use when adding a function, creating an endpoint, implementing a new Firestore collection, or building a feature in an existing Firebase project.
│
│    firebase-development:debug
│
│      Systematically troubleshoots Firebase-specific issues including emulator failures, Firestore rules violations, Cloud Functions errors, Firebase Auth problems, and Firebase deploy failures. Use when Firebase emulators won't start, Firestore returns PERMISSION_DENIED, Cloud Functions return errors, Firebase Auth fails in the emulator, or firebase deploy fails.
│
│    firebase-development
│
│      Routes Firebase development tasks to specialized sub-skills covering project setup, feature development, debugging, and validation. Use when starting a Firebase project, adding Cloud Functions or Firestore collections, troubleshooting Firebase emulator or deployment issues, or reviewing Firebase security rules and architecture.
│
│    firebase-development:project-setup
│
│      Initializes new Firebase projects with TypeScript, emulators, authentication, and security rules using proven architecture patterns. Use when starting a new Firebase project, running firebase init, or setting up Firebase for the first time in a repository.
│
│    firebase-development:validate
│
│      Reviews Firebase projects against security best practices, architecture patterns, and production readiness checklists. Use when auditing Firebase security rules, reviewing Firebase configuration, checking Firebase project architecture, or preparing a Firebase project for production deployment.

│
└  Use --skill <name> to install specific skills
